title: Lever Handle
summary: Repairs the control at the top of the Gauntlet of Shar elevator.

fields.Use: Insert the handle in the Lever Base at X −740, Y −781 to operate the elevator from above.
fields.Acquisition: On the floor at the bottom of the elevator near the waypoint, X −742, Y −768.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
